init.title: Connection
init.description:
The logger serves values from a cache that refreshes every few seconds. Longer intervals mean fewer database writes.

By default the integration connects for each poll and releases the logger in between, because the logger stops uploading inverter data to the Deye Cloud while a connection stays open. Keep the connection open only if you do not use the Deye Cloud or the Deye app away from home; polls are then faster and more reliable, and 10 seconds becomes a useful interval.

experimental.title: {model} support is experimental
experimental.description: The register map for this inverter family has not been confirmed on real hardware yet. If any values or settings look wrong, download the diagnostics from the device page (they include a register dump) and open an issue at {url}.

unsupported.title: {model} is not supported yet
unsupported.description: Deye Local does not have a register map for this inverter yet, so only its identity is shown. Download the diagnostics from the device page (they include a register dump) and open an issue at {url} to help add it.

set_tou_schedule.name: Set time of use schedule
set_tou_schedule.description: Write the time of use table (the inverter's Work Mode / Time Of Use screen) in one go. Only registers that change are written, then read back to confirm.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: The inverter to change. Can be left out when only one is set up.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: Exactly 6 slots, in order. Each slot can set time (HH:MM, start of the slot), power (W), batt (target SOC, %), grid_charge (true/false), gen (true/false) and voltage (V). Fields left out, or an empty slot {}, keep what the inverter holds.
